quest.title: Recuperating From a Severe Illness
quest.description: As Anna has been recovering from her illness, she's finally started playing all around the city again. However, Anthony can't seem to find her anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: How did this happen...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Just in time, too. Anna's been getting better ever since eating the medicine prescribed by that doctor.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: When she wasn't well, she needed a lot of rest, and so spent a lot of time convalescing at home.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Now that she's better, she's started pestering me every day to go out at play, and I couldn't refuse her.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: But now, I absolutely cannot find her. I have no idea where she's gone. Please help me find her!

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I'll be waiting here. Please hurry.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: She just got better, and now she's scampering about. What will we do if something happens to her...?

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I've already been searching for quite a while. I haven't looked in the vicinity of the Adventurers' Guild yet, but I'm just beat at this point...

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: You should start your search over there. Who knows, maybe Cyrus has noticed something...

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I hope you find her, or I'll have to go out again...

choices.text: You seem quite happy about it.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Happy? This is no laughing matter. She's only gotten a little better, and now she's flying about like a kite!

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: When she gets back, I'll give her what for.

choices.text: She'll come back once she gets hungry.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Are you taking my sister for some sort of cat? And she's only just recovered. How can we let her go hungry?

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Alright, alright. Please help me find her, I'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I'm so high up! My brother will never find me here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Wah! How'd you get up here, and without a sound, too!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: No, wait. How did you even find me?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Me? I just climbed up here.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: My brother's looking for me? Huh. It's been some time, hasn't it? I hadn't noticed.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I got it. I'll go back soon. Just let me stay here for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Have you found Anna?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's on top of a windmill.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: A windmill!? How did that girl get up there? I'm calling the Knights of Favonius right now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She said she'll be back soon.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: O—Oh. Is that so? Well, she's fine, and that's what matters. You scared me there for a moment! I thought she was stuck on top of a windmill.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Thank you, I'll go look for her now.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Running off like that when she's only just recovered... I have to teach her a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Oh? You're here? That's unusual.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen a certain girl?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: A girl? Oh, you mean Anna? I did see her. She was heading for that windmill over there.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I'm still quite puzzled by it, myself. I thought she was unwell. Where did she suddenly get all that energy from?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: She greeted me and just ran by.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: That kid... Do you have any idea when she recovered from her illness?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I'm so high up! My brother will never find me here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Whoa! How'd you get up here, and without a sound, too!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Also, how did you even find me?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Ah, I know. Mr. Cyrus must have told you.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: He's always taken care of my brother and I, and I greeted him as I was passing by. He looked so surprised, too!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Maybe I should try out for the Adventurers' Guild and become an Adventurer. That might be nice!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: What? My brother's looking for me? Huh. It's been some time, hasn't it? I hadn't noticed at all!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I got it. Just let me stay here for a while, I'll go back myself.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Have you found Anna yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's on top of a windmill.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: A windmill!? How did that girl get up there? I'm going up there right now...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: What? She wants to try becoming an adventurer?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: She's getting ahead of herself, she hasn't even fully recovered yet!

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Don't get me wrong. Once she's well, I don't have any problems with her going out to see the world.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Thanks, I'll go look for her. Running off like that when she's only just recovered... I have to teach her a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Once I find Anna, I'll have to teach her a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: The wind feels great here. I'd love to see how it feels in some faraway place.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: It seems like that kid has recovered from her illness.
